jobs.title: Data & AI Analyst
jobs.description: Work includes preparing and analysing large transactional datasets from multiple source systems, and automating data preparation workflows using SQL and Python. The listing asks for 1-3 years of relevant experience in data analytics or engineering, proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit.

jobs.title: AI & Data Consultant
jobs.description: An AI & Data Consultant role at Deloitte Sydney, posted early October 2026. Asks for 2+ years in Data and/or ML Engineering, hands-on experience in Python or SQL, advanced SQL and database skills, experience with data modelling, and hands-on development in AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks or Snowflake. Prior consulting or client-facing experience is highly regarded.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: Senior role focused on data pipelines, data quality controls, and productionising machine learning at Commonwealth Bank. The core stack includes Python/R, SQL, GitHub Actions CI/CD, big data and distributed processing, MLOps and data quality tooling. Requirements: strong data engineering background with production ML experience.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - ML & GenAI
jobs.description: A Senior Data Scientist role at Commonwealth Bank building ML and agentic AI solutions for customer service, with hands-on Python, SQL, and MLOps work plus input on data governance. The role is on-site in Sydney and focuses on production ML systems and GenAI applications.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: A credit-risk modelling Data Scientist role at Beforepay Group in Sydney, in-person. It asks for strong Python and SQL, machine learning knowledge, and a salary range of AUD $80,000 - $150,000 per year.

jobs.title: Performance Data Scientist
jobs.description: A performance-analysis Data Scientist role at Cricket Australia in Albion QLD (Brisbane), hybrid, posted approximately 4 days ago. It asks for R or Python, SQL, and experience querying data warehouses.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: A Lead Data Scientist role at Culture Amp in Sydney, hybrid. Asks for experience leading a team, deep SQL and Python skills, and enterprise database experience.

jobs.title: 软件算法工程师（AI/图形图像）
jobs.description: 参与联影产品的AI算法开发工作或图形算法开发工作。要求方面，学历为硕士及以上、博士优先，专业包括数学、物理、生物医学工程、电子、计算机等；需熟悉至少一种医学图像后处理算法（如重建、分割、配准、深度学习等），有CUDA、OpenGL等并行或图形开发经验者优先。

jobs.title: 软件算法工程师（大模型方向）
jobs.description: 负责大语言模型方面的算法开发、优化、应用落地。任职要求包括硕士及以上学历、人工智能相关背景，有预训练大模型或GPT类研发经验者优先，并要求能熟练使用英语。薪资1.5-3万，岗位编号J17489。

jobs.title: AI Agent 算法工程师
jobs.description: 需要计算机或数学相关本科及以上学历、熟悉Python，理解Transformer和Agent架构范式，并熟悉任务规划、工具调用、多步推理等机制；了解Agent RL训练（过程奖励建模、轨迹优化等）者优先。岗位覆盖北京、深圳、上海。

jobs.title: 混元VLM预训练数据算法工程师
jobs.description: 岗位要求：计算机科学、人工智能、自动化等相关专业硕士及以上学历，1年以上多模态大模型或计算机视觉领域研发经验；工作内容涉及多模态数据的处理流水线与数据配比设计。岗位在北京/深圳/上海。

jobs.title: 混元vlm算法研究员-后训练/基座能力提升方向
jobs.description: 岗位职责包括个性化与长期记忆机制的算法研发，以及后训练阶段的数据合成与用户反馈闭环建模。混元大语言模型后训练算法工程师-Memory方向，要求三年以上研发经验，岗位在深圳/北京/上海。

jobs.title: 27届秋招-算法工程师
jobs.description: 要求2027届本科及以上学历毕业生，计算机、电子工程、自动化、数学等相关专业，并要求具备机器学习、数据挖掘、NLP等至少一个方向的基础，以及Hadoop等海量数据处理经验。岗位覆盖北京、上海、杭州、广州。
